correctness.rationale: For finite connected cellular G⊂RP^2, let u represent the nonzero ambient H^1(F2) class. G−A is local iff the restriction of u is δf for a vertex 0-cochain on surviving edges, so the minimum deletion count equals min_f |supp(u+δf)|, exactly the switching-invariant frustration index of the associated signed graph. Under cellular Poincaré duality, support maps bijectively to dual edges, cocycle condition to cycle condition and nontrivial cohomology to the unique nonzero H_1 class; hence α(G)=ew_1(G*). A homologically nontrivial closed dual walk lifts from a vertex to its deck partner in the S² double cover and conversely; minimum length equals the antipodal shortest path, since any nonzero mod-2 closed walk admits at least one nontrivial circuit. The link breadth formulas follow by direct substitution into Boyle–Spyropoulos, conditional on the cited alternating-link theorem. Loops, parallel edges and 1-edge projective circuits do not invalidate the mod-2 cochain reasoning. This is an exact all-cellular proof, not finite sampling.
